edit.description: `Extraction` (src/kind.rs:1079) holds `primitives` privately, so no consumer can ask whether a kind composes `Primitive::Directives` (src/kind.rs:1120). Add one narrow predicate — the declaring-kind test the seed set needs — rather than exposing the vector: an export with exactly one consumer (`specs/process/engineering.md`, "An export earns its consumer"). Where the predicate also names the `DirectiveSyntax` (src/kind.rs:1134), the traversal can apply the seed's own syntax to a reached body instead of assuming `AtImport`.

`directive_members_from_resolved` (src/compose.rs:1365) today copies `features.directives`, which is populated only where the kind composes the primitive (src/kind.rs:1183) — so every non-`memory` member arrives with an empty occurrence list and the middle hop is invisible. It holds `uaf.units` with their bodies already in memory: extract `extract::body_at_imports` off every unit's body, and mark each member with whether its own kind *declares* the primitive (it takes the built-in defs, already in hand at both call sites). The occurrence list and the declaring flag are separate facts: the flag is the traversal's seed set, the list is what a member carries once reached. A body-less kind (`Content::Fields`) extracts nothing, unchanged.

`classify_directives` (src/graph.rs:1508) becomes a breadth-first traversal over the occurrence sets rather than one flat pass over every member's: seed at the members whose kind declares the primitive, class their occurrences as today (member / backed path / unbacked pointer), then expand into each member-class target and class *its* occurrences, one hop per round, capped at `MAX_IMPORT_HOPS` (src/builtin_kind.rs:37) exactly as `live_members` already rounds (src/graph.rs:1292). A reached member's occurrences are classed; an unreached non-declaring member's are not — that is the ruling's second half. The edge is emitted even when the target is already visited (the ring's closing arc is the finding `acyclic` exists for); only the expansion is skipped. `DirectiveMember` (src/graph.rs:1464) gains the declaring flag. The `acyclic` doc comment (src/graph.rs:1145) says the import relation is scoped to the format's execution — it now spans kinds, and the `CLAUDE.md -> rule -> CLAUDE.md` ring is the example it should name.

The floor-tier classing call site (src/gate.rs:396) passes `builtin_defs` (src/gate.rs:236) through to `directive_members_from_resolved` for the declaring-kind flag. The unbacked-pointer advisory (src/gate.rs:403) is unchanged in severity and wiring: an occurrence a reached rule carries is the same pure fact an occurrence a memory file carries is, so it surfaces on the same non-gating channel.

`explain`'s classing call site (src/read.rs:2481) takes the same defs argument; `builtin_defs` is already bound there for the registration derivation (src/read.rs:2473). The edges `explain` narrates widen with the traversal — a rule that imports now shows its outbound `@import` — which is the read/gate edge-set unity (READ-EDGE-UNIFY) holding, not a second enumeration.

The `member()` fixture helper (tests/it/directive_classing.rs:32) gains the declaring flag so its call sites stay legible, and the three existing verdict tests declare their memory members as seeds. New cases pin the ruling: a non-declaring member reached by an import carries its own occurrences (the middle hop yields an edge); the same member unreached carries none (no edge, no unbacked finding); a chain longer than `MAX_IMPORT_HOPS` stops at the cap. The end-to-end ring assertion at the bottom of the file re-spells over `CLAUDE.md -> rule -> CLAUDE.md` — the ring 0070's Context names as reported green — and must now fail the run through `graph.acyclic`.

summary: A file an import reaches carries the directives its format executes, whatever kind governs it — hop-capped, so a cross-kind import ring stops reading green.

tests.asserts: an import target whose kind declares no directives still carries its own occurrences (edge, and an unbacked finding where the target resolves to nothing); the same member unreached carries none; the chain stops at MAX_IMPORT_HOPS; and `CLAUDE.md -> rule -> CLAUDE.md` fails the run through graph.acyclic

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the cross-kind ring failing and the unreached non-declaring member silent; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
notes: 0070, ruled 2026-09-29, reversing the fork's own recommendation. The dogfood is inert here: no `@`-line exists anywhere under CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .flume/ or docs/ (grepped this tick), so the widening adds no finding to our own harness and the gate's green is not evidence the traversal ran — the fixtures are. scoped at f5601304
